newsitem.title: FRANCE: Missing French girl said sighted in Martinique.
newsitem.headline: Missing French girl said sighted in Martinique.

text.p: Police searching for a 10-year-old girl whose disappearance last November caused a national outcry said on Saturday she may have been spotted on the French Caribbean island of Martinique.

Marion Wagon vanished after leaving school in the southwestern town of Agen last November 14, triggering a nationwide hunt amid concern over a possible copy-cat abduction following a spate of highly publicised paedophile murders in neighouring Belgium.
Police issued an identikit picture of a man in his forties with a chin-strap beard who was seen with a girl resembling Marion by a French woman tourist in Les Trois-Ilets, Martinique, last January.

It was the firmest reported sighting of the girl, whose portrait has been on posters in town halls and post offices in France and neighbouring countries, and even on milk packs in supermarkets all year.

"We have known for a while but this trail was kept secret," Marion's father Michel Wagon said in a television interview. "It's certainly the most promising trail. It proves that Marion is still alive."
He said the tourist had described meeting a girl who said her name was Marion and she wanted to return to home to Agen.
"If someone is holding Marion in Martinique or in France, let him hand her back and it will be over," the father said.
Detectives had checked between 200 and 300 tips since Marion disappeared, searching forests and quarries, but have found no trace of her in her home region.
